name: P1 - Crash alert that cannot leak data

nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Set THIS workflow as the Error workflow of every workflow you want watched (Workflow settings). The Error Trigger only fires for automatic (published) runs, not manual test runs.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Put YOUR alert webhook here (for example a Slack incoming webhook). It is a secret: keep it in this one node and never share a file that contains the real value.

nodes.name: Redact error text
nodes.notes: Allow-list redaction: only known technical words survive, so a name, id or e-mail inside an error message can never reach the alert channel. Source with comments: code/p1-redact-error.js.

nodes.name: Send alert
nodes.notes: Retry is on: a duplicate alert is acceptable, a lost alert is not. onError = Continue so a dead alert channel cannot fail this workflow in a loop. Slack-style incoming webhooks accept {"text": ...}; adapt the body for your receiver.
